description: A class representing an in-memory database for managing users and games in a Tic Tac Toe application.

classes.name: Database
classes.description: Class to simulate a database that stores users and game state in memory with methods for user management and game state manipulation.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes user, game, and history dictionaries along with their respective counters.

methods.name: dict create_user(self, username: str, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user with a hashed password and stores it in the database.

methods.name: Optional[dict] get_user(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their ID.

methods.name: Optional[dict] get_user_by_email(self, email: str)
methods.description: Finds a user in the database by their email address.

methods.name: Optional[dict] verify_password(self, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Verifies a user's password using bcrypt.

methods.name: dict create_game(self, player_x_id: int, player_o_id: int)
methods.description: Creates a new Tic Tac Toe game and stores it in the database.

methods.name: Optional[dict] get_game(self, game_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a game by its ID.

methods.name: Optional[dict] update_game(self, game_id: int, game_state: dict)
methods.description: Updates the state of an existing game.

methods.name: dict create_game_history(self, game_id: int, winner_id: Optional[int], is_draw: bool)
methods.description: Records the outcome of a game in the game history.

ctags.name: create_game
ctags.pattern: /^    def create_game(self, player_x_id: int, player_o_id: int) -> dict:$/

ctags.name: create_game_history
ctags.pattern: /^    def create_game_history(self, game_id: int, winner_id: Optional[int], is_draw: bool) -> dict/
ctags.signature: (self, game_id: int, winner_id: Optional[int], is_draw: bool)

ctags.name: create_user
ctags.pattern: /^    def create_user(self, username: str, email: str, password: str) -> dict:$/
ctags.signature: (self, username: str, email: str, password: str)

ctags.name: update_game
ctags.pattern: /^    def update_game(self, game_id: int, game_state: dict) -> Optional[dict]:$/

ctags.name: verify_password
ctags.pattern: /^    def verify_password(self, email: str, password: str) -> Optional[dict]:$/
